name: AUDIO

name: AUDIO
description: "Based on the results of the first V1.0 of Audio Alchemy, the D/A converter was announced as the second to aim for higher grade digital reproduction.DDE stands for Digital Decoding Engine.The D/A converter uses the latest version of the bit stream method DAC, and the analog and digital sections are designed separately to achieve high-quality sound reproduction.The digital input is 3-frequency automatic switching of 32/44.1/48kHz, and the terminals are equipped with a coaxial Route 3 using BNC terminals as well as one optical system."
